description: Defines classes and functions for managing lists of memory blocks, including intrusive linked list, thread-safe stack, and block stealing mechanisms, used in memory pool management.

classes.name: intrusive_memory_block_list
classes.description: Intrusive linked list managing memory blocks with push, pop, and steal operations.

classes.name: concurrent_free_memory_block_list
classes.description: Thread-safe stack of memory blocks with push, pop, and steal operations.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a memory block to the list or stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns a memory block from the list.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop a memory block, returns nullptr if empty.

methods.name: steal_top
methods.description: Transfers the top element from another list.

methods.name: try_pop_batch
methods.description: Removes a batch of n memory blocks.

methods.name: steal_blocks
methods.description: Transfers all blocks from another list.
